author: Rahul Verma
text: Hello everyone! Quick question: where can I find the initial deviation reporting template?

author: Sana Khan
text: Welcome Rahul! It is located in the QMS electronic portal under Form-DEV-01.

author: Rahul Verma
text: Thanks Sana! Who should I assign as the primary QA reviewer when submitting?

author: Priya Rao
text: Priya Rao, QA Lead, owns deviation management.

author: Priya Rao
text: Assign it to me in the QMS workflow and I will review the triage classification.

author: Rahul Verma
text: Understood Priya, will do. Appreciate the guidance!

author: Sana Khan
text: Make sure you include the lot number and exact location timestamp in section 1.

author: Rahul Verma
text: Got it, filling out the details now.

author: Priya Rao
text: Also check SOP-001 for classification guidelines if you are uncertain whether it is minor or major.

author: Rahul Verma
text: Reading SOP-001 right now. Very clear!
